name: Monkey D. Luffy
description: The captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. He ate the Gomu Gomu no Mi, which allows his body to stretch like rubber. His dream is to find the One Piece and become the Pirate King.

name: Roronoa Zoro
description: Roronoa Zoro is a swordsman who dreams of becoming the world's greatest. He is a loyal member of the Straw Hat Pirates, known for his incredible strength and three-sword style.

name: Nami
description: Nami is the navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates. She is a skilled cartographer and thief who joins Luffy in pursuit of the One Piece while working towards her goal of creating a complete world map.

name: Sanji
description: Sanji is the cook of the Straw Hat Pirates, known for his powerful kicking techniques and chivalrous nature. He dreams of finding the All Blue, a sea where all the fish of the world meet.

name: Usopp
description: Usopp is the sharpshooter and the crew's sniper. He is known for his great imagination and ability to craft innovative weapons. Usopp dreams of becoming a brave warrior of the sea like his father.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
description: The main protagonist of Naruto. Naruto is a young ninja with the goal of becoming the Hokage, the leader of his village. He is known for his never-give-up attitude and for having the Nine-Tails Fox sealed inside him.

name: Kakashi Hatake
description: A jounin ninja from Konoha who is known as a prodigy of his age. He was formerly part of the elite ANBU unit, but now he leads Team 7. Known as 'Copy Ninja Kakashi' for his use of the Sharingan.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
description: Sasuke Uchiha is a talented and serious ninja, known for his Sharingan and his desire for revenge against his older brother, Itachi. He is initially a member of Team 7 and later plays a major role in the series' events.

name: Sakura Haruno
description: Sakura Haruno is a ninja from Konoha and a member of Team 7. Known for her exceptional strength, medical ninjutsu skills, and being a key figure in Naruto's growth.

special_attributes.Signature Move: Chakra Enhanced Strength, Cherry Blossom Jutsu

name: Eren Yeager
description: Eren Yeager is the main protagonist of Attack on Titan, known for his drive to destroy the Titans and reclaim humanity's freedom. His intense desire for revenge pushes him to extraordinary lengths.

special_attributes.Berserk Mode: Can temporarily lose control of his Titan form

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description: Mikasa Ackerman is one of the top soldiers of the Survey Corps and Eren's adoptive sister. She is an incredibly skilled fighter and is dedicated to protecting Eren at all costs.

name: Armin Arlert
description: Armin Arlert is a close friend of Eren and Mikasa. Though initially weak, he has a brilliant strategic mind, often coming up with plans that save the Survey Corps from danger.

name: Levi Ackerman
description: Levi Ackerman is known as humanity's strongest soldier. His unparalleled combat abilities and leadership make him a key figure in the fight against the Titans.

name: Goku
description: Goku is a Saiyan who was sent to Earth as a baby. Over the course of the series, he becomes one of the strongest fighters in the universe, constantly seeking challenges to grow stronger.

name: Vegeta
description: Vegeta is the prince of the Saiyan race and initially one of Goku's greatest rivals. Over time, he becomes one of Earth's strongest defenders.

name: Frieza
description: Frieza is one of the most powerful and infamous villains in the *Dragon Ball* universe. He is the emperor of the universe, known for his cruelty and tyrannical rule.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
description: Ichigo Kurosaki is a teenager who becomes a Soul Reaper after accidentally receiving the powers of Rukia Kuchiki. He fights evil spirits known as Hollows and defends the living from threats from the Spirit World.

name: Rukia Kuchiki
description: Rukia Kuchiki is a Soul Reaper who becomes Ichigo's mentor and the catalyst for Ichigo's transformation into a Soul Reaper. She is a member of the prestigious Kuchiki clan.

name: Orihime Inoue
description: Orihime Inoue is a close friend of Ichigo and an important character in the *Bleach* series. She possesses powerful healing abilities and later becomes a key figure in the battles against the Hollows.

special_attributes.Abilities: Shun Shun Rikka (Six Flowers of the Guardian)

name: Uryu Ishida
description: Uryu Ishida is a Quincy and one of Ichigo's closest friends. He initially distances himself from others but eventually becomes a trusted ally in the battle against the forces of darkness.

name: Yuji Itadori
description: Yuji Itadori is the main protagonist of *Jujutsu Kaisen*. He swallows a cursed object, which allows him to possess incredible abilities but also puts his life in constant danger from curses.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
description: Megumi Fushiguro is a talented jujutsu sorcerer and a classmate of Yuji. He specializes in the use of shikigami, summoning powerful spirits to assist him in battle.

name: Nobara Kugisaki
description: Nobara Kugisaki is a powerful jujutsu sorcerer who uses a unique combination of cursed energy and nails to defeat curses. She is known for her tough attitude and sense of justice.

name: Satoru Gojo
description: Satoru Gojo is one of the most powerful jujutsu sorcerers in *Jujutsu Kaisen*. His mastery of cursed energy and his unshakable confidence make him a key figure in the battle against curses.

name: Izuku Midoriya
description: Izuku Midoriya is the protagonist of *My Hero Academia*. Born without a Quirk, he inherits the power of the legendary hero All Might and strives to become the greatest hero in the world.

name: Katsuki Bakugo
description: Katsuki Bakugo is a hot-headed and powerful student at U.A. High School. Known for his explosive personality and his explosive Quirk, he constantly strives to become the number one hero.

name: Ochaco Uraraka
description: A student at U.A. High School with a cheerful personality. She wants to become a pro hero to financially support her family.

name: Shoto Todoroki
description: A powerful hero student born from a famous hero lineage. He possesses both fire and ice abilities.

name: Edward Elric
description: The youngest State Alchemist in history, determined to restore his brother's body using alchemy.

name: Alphonse Elric
description: Edward’s younger brother whose soul is bound to a suit of armor after a failed alchemy experiment.

name: Roy Mustang
description: A charismatic State Alchemist known for his flame-based alchemy and leadership skills.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
description: A kind-hearted boy who becomes a Demon Slayer to save his sister and avenge his family.

name: Nezuko Kamado
description: Tanjiro’s younger sister who was turned into a demon but retains her humanity.

name: Ken Kaneki
description: A college student who becomes a half-ghoul after a tragic accident.

name: Light Yagami
description: A brilliant student who discovers the Death Note and seeks to become the god of a new world.

name: L Lawliet
description: A mysterious and eccentric detective determined to catch Kira.

name: Kirito
description: A skilled solo player trapped in a virtual reality MMORPG.

name: Asuna
description: A strong and compassionate fighter known as the Lightning Flash.
